## Primary research

Goindani, Mahak, Qiaoling Liu, Josh Chao, and Valentin Jijkoun. 2017. *Employer Industry Classification using Job Postings*. User-supplied manuscript, `icdm_2017_industryclassification.pdf`. The supplied filename identifies ICDM 2017; proceedings metadata and DOI have not been independently established here.

| Site content | Source locator |
|---|---|
| Research motivation and entity-normalization problem | Abstract and Section I |
| Collection period and class distribution | Section II, Tables I–II |
| Title and name features | Section III-A, equations 1–6, Table III |
| Model libraries and cost sensitivity | Section III-B |
| Disagreement review and agreement audit | Section IV-A |
| Utility definitions | Section IV-B, equations 7–9 |
| Classification and utility results | Tables IV–V |
| Feature ablation and detected errors | Tables VI–VII |
| Limitations and future work | Sections V–VII |

## Classification context

U.S. Census Bureau. [2017 NAICS Sector 48–49: Transportation and Warehousing](https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2017/econ/economic-census/naics-sector-48-49.html).

U.S. Census Bureau. [2017 NAICS Sector 62: Health Care and Social Assistance](https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2017/econ/economic-census/naics-sector-62.html).

These sources verify the sector codes. They are not used as evidence for the paper's performance or for present-day job prospects.
